text:
Carlos M: Heads-up: I'll be in Toronto next week (King West)  any must-try brunch spots or vegan-friendly pubs near the office?
Zoe: Try Mildred's Temple Kitchen for brunch  great pancakes and they do solid veg options. 10-12min walk from King St W.
Ellen: For vegan pub vibes, check out The Plant Cafe (not huge, nice taps) or Hogtown Vegan on Queen. both good late daytime menus.
Marcus: If you want something quick and casual, Kupfert & Kim does GF bowls and amazing salads  super fast.
Carlos M: awesome. looking for one more place thats good for a team lunch (~6 ppl) and can take a reso. any recs?
Zoe: Pizzeria Libretto (King West location) takes groups and has gf crust option. casual, reliable.
Ellen: For a slightly nicer sit-down, Bar Isabel is a bit south but they handle groups well and have veg tapas. book early.
Marcus: Pro tip: bring a backup plan on Fri lunchtime  King West fills up with office crowds.
KitchenBot: Saved to trip notes: "TO: King West brunch + vegan pubs: Mildred's, Hogtown Vegan, Kupfert & Kim, Pizzeria Libretto, Bar Isabel." Run `kitchen-hours toronto Mildreds` to check weekend hours.
Carlos M: sweet, thanks y'all. anyone tried the weekend brunch wait times at Mildred's?
Zoe: long on weekends (30-60). they take walk-in + waitlist app.
Ellen: we once managed a 20-min wait by arriving at 10:45. beverages were worth it. :coffee:
Marcus: If you want to avoid waits, go Sat 9:30 or Mon for a calmer crowd.
Carlos M: perfect. I'll book Pizzeria Libretto for team lunch and swing by Mildred's Sat morning. thanks! :raised_hands:
